deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (US and non-US applicants alike).
deadline.quote: TOEFL scores are valid for two years and should not expire before the December 1st application deadline.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and is not considered in the review.
gre_general.quote: A GRE test is not required, nor is it considered in the review process

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed before applying; you choose a thesis advisor after three lab rotations in the first year.
supervisor.quote: No. Admitted students are assigned a temporary academic advisor for the first year. At the end of the first year, after completing three lab rotations, students choose a thesis advisor.

funding.value: Fellowship support covers the first year, and funding is assured for the whole PhD while you are in good standing.
funding.quote: Funding is assured for the duration of Ph.D. training provided students are making progress and in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: Both BS and MS holders apply; a 3-year bachelor's alone is not enough.
entry_route.quote: Having prior research experience gives you a definite advantage when applying, whether you have a BS or MS degree.

english_waiver.value: Exempt from TOEFL/IELTS with at least three years of undergraduate or master's study taught in English.
english_waiver.quote: You are exempt from submitting a TOEFL or IELTS score if you are a Permanent Resident, a US citizen, or an international applicant with a minimum of three years of undergraduate or master's degree studies with the mode of instruction being English.

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: Umbrella for Biochemistry, Cell and Developmental Biology, Cellular and Molecular Pharmacology, Microbiology and Molecular Genetics, and Physiology and Integrative Biology; single admissions committee with first-year rotations. The FAQ says an acceptable TOEFL total is above 100 despite the section minimums.
